summary: Full backend + frontend testing of PropBharat app. 21/21 backend tests passed. All core features work. One critical routing bug found in Admin/Agent dashboards on direct URL navigation.

ui_bugs.issue: Direct URL navigation to /admin or /agent redirects to '/' due to auth loading race condition. useEffect runs with user=null before checkAuth() completes. Fix: add 'if (loading) return;' before the redirect checks in useEffect.
ui_bugs.selector: useEffect in AdminDashboard.js line 20-24, AgentDashboard.js similar

ui_bugs.issue: Default tab is 'stats' but there's no tab content rendered for 'stats' — the tab area below stat cards is empty until user clicks Users/Properties/Leads. Should default to 'users' tab or render something for stats tab.

action_items: Fix AdminDashboard.js and AgentDashboard.js: In useEffect, add 'if (loading) return;' before redirect checks so auth state resolves before redirecting. This fixes direct URL navigation to /admin and /agent.
Consider defaulting admin dashboard tab to 'users' instead of 'stats'
critical_code_review_comments: AdminDashboard.js line 20-24: useEffect depends on [user] but does not check 'loading' - causes race condition on direct URL navigation. Fix: add 'if (loading) return;' as first line in the effect.
AgentDashboard.js likely has same issue (check useEffect auth guard)

success_rate.frontend: 90% - all features work except direct URL navigation to /admin and /agent

seed_data_creation: Backend test created TEST_* user (registered via /api/auth/register) - may need cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend APIs all working. Frontend core flows verified: homepage, Buy/Rent/Sell tabs, city/type filters, EMI Calculator, Map View (Google Maps with markers), Login modal, admin dashboard (via dropdown nav), Hindi language translation, logout. The one critical bug is direct URL navigation to /admin redirects to homepage due to loading race condition. Test by: navigate to / -> login as admin -> go to /admin URL directly (before auth loads) -> it redirects to /.
rca_of_issue: In AdminDashboard.js, useEffect has dependency [user]. When user navigates directly to /admin, React renders the component with user=null (auth not loaded yet), the useEffect fires immediately with user=null, and navigate('/') is called. Fix: in both AdminDashboard and AgentDashboard useEffects, add 'if (loading) return;' as first line, where loading comes from useAuth(). This prevents premature redirect while auth session is being verified from localStorage.
